(prin1 ;;; -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
(let* ((purpose (make-symbol "char-table-object-purpose"))
       (parent (make-char-table purpose 'parent))
       (child (make-char-table purpose 'initial))
       results)
  (set-char-table-parent child parent)
  (push (aref child 65) results)
  (set-char-table-range child nil 'default)
  (push (aref child 65) results)
  (aset child 65 nil)
  (push (aref child 65) results)
  (set-char-table-range child nil nil)
  (push (aref child 65) results)
  (set-char-table-range child t nil)
  (push (aref child 66) results)
  (set-char-table-range child nil 'replacement-default)
  (push (aref child 66) results)
  (set-char-table-range child '(10 . 20) 'range)
  (push (char-table-range child '(11 . 14)) results)
  (let ((first (make-char-table purpose nil))
        (second (make-char-table purpose nil)))
    (aset first 700 'old)
    (aset first 700 'current)
    (aset second 700 'current)
    (push (equal first second) results))
  (put purpose 'char-table-extra-slots 2)
  (let ((with-extras (make-char-table purpose 'slot-initial)))
    (push (list (char-table-extra-slot with-extras 0)
                (char-table-extra-slot with-extras 1)
                (eq purpose (char-table-subtype with-extras))) results))
  (let ((weak (make-hash-table :test 'eq :weakness 'key)))
    ;; The table stays live; replacing a slot must drop the old value even
    ;; when lookup returns the new value correctly through another index.
    (funcall (lambda ()
               (let ((old (vector 'overwritten-value)))
                 (puthash old 'present weak)
                 (aset child 900 old)
                 (aset child 900 'replacement)
                 (setq old nil))))
    (garbage-collect)
    (push (list (aref child 900) (hash-table-count weak)) results))
  (nreverse results))
)
